items.headline: Albemarle to Release Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Results on Wednesday, November 4, 2026
items.snippet: Albemarle Corporation (NYSE: ALB) will release Q3 2026 earnings on November 4, 2026.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized the tight lithium market due to strong demand in EVs and stationary storage, with supply lagging demand. The company maintained its 2026 outlook, expecting the high end of scenario ranges.

items.headline: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold ALB Stock After a 29% Dip in 6 Months?
items.snippet: ALB shares have tumbled 29.1% in the past six months. A pullback in lithium prices has weighed on the stock amid softer China EV demand, elevated inventories and mine restarts.

items.headline: Albemarle reaches tentative wage agreement with union day before Chilean strike
items.snippet: Albemarle reached a tentative wage agreement with Chilean union leadership ahead of a strike; the proposal must be ratified by member vote.

items.headline: Market Chatter: Lithium Miners' Profits Surge as Battery Storage Demand Drives Prices Higher
items.snippet: Lithium producers from China to Australia have seen profits soar as demand from the energy storage sector pushes prices higher. Albemarle (ALB) noted global lithium demand grew 45% through May, significantly outstripping supply.
